thread:
sahil: FYI partner (EdgeScale) is proposing delegated reporting where they send us seq numbers + tombstones instead of deleting events on their side. they want our ingestion to accept out-of-order deliveries and apply the latest seq_no. planning call?

maya: Sounds reasonable. Need to nail semantics: is tombstone a hard delete (remove billing line) or a soft zero-ing for reconciliation? also need SLA on replay window.

oliver: From ingestion POV we can do a seq_no gate: persist last_seq_per_partner+customer and only apply messages with seq_no > last_seq. That handles duplicates and simple replays. caveats: out-of-order larger than retention and concurrent patch ordering.

oliver: Quick example payload they sent (we should standardize):

```json
{
  "customer_id": "acct_01G4...",
  "sku_id": "redwood-gen2",
  "usage": 120.5,
  "usage_unit": "gen-token",
  "window_start": "2025-06-09T00:00:00Z",
  "window_end": "2025-06-09T01:00:00Z",
  "seq_no": 98765,
  "tombstone": false
}
```

maya: Good — finance will want sku_id + pricing_tier in the payload so they can map to our ratecard without a separate enrichment job.

anna: (finance) please include pricing_tier or plan_id. tombstones: we treat as reversal of previous usage line — but need contract to define whether it's "delete" vs "negative usage". prefer explicit tombstone:true + original_seq_ref optional.

oliver: Implementation notes:
- store last_seq per (partner, customer, sku, granularity) as int
- only accept msg if seq_no > last_seq OR if seq_no == last_seq and idempotent (exact match)
- if tombstone:true, mark original row deleted and emit a credit event to billing ledger (not just drop)
- support replay window of 90 days, but we only auto-apply out-of-order within 72h by default, anything older goes to manual review queue

maya: ops question: do we expose a webhook response codes for tombstones/replays so partner can backoff?

oliver: yes. we'll return 200 for accepted, 409 for stale seq_no, 422 for malformed, 202 for queued/manual-review. include X-Last-Seq header in response.

devops-bot: [webhook-delivery] delivery failed for partner edge-scale (3/3). last status 5xx from ingestion endpoint. see https://internal.ops/redwood/webhooks/4362

maya: thanks. @oliver can you check retry/backpressure behavior? partner says they may burst replays after debugging.

oliver: we have batching + rate-limit per partner. for replays we should allow a temporary replay-mode token that lifts rate-limits for a short window with manual approval. avoids accidental throttling when partner backfills.

anna: finance: we need audit trail for any tombstone-generated credits. ledger entries must reference original_seq and tombstone_seq. tagged for customer disputes.

maya: action items:
1) eng (oliver) - implement seq_no gating, response codes, X-Last-Seq header, tombstone credit flow (ETA: 2w)
2) partnerships (maya) - update partner contract + webhook spec (include pricing_tier, plan_id, sku_id) and ask for replay cadence + auth scheme
3) finance (anna) - confirm ledger format and credit semantics by EOD Tuesday
4) ops - add manual-review queue + replay-mode escalation playbook
5) schedule 30-min sync with EdgeScale next Thu 10am PT

sahil: +1 to all. prioritize tombstone audit/ledger mapping — disputes are a high risk.

maya: i'll draft the webhook spec and ping here when ready. will include sample cURL and canonical JSON.

oliver: pinging infra on retry backoff path. also will put a small integration test harness in dev that simulates out-of-order seqs.

sahil: perfect. :thumbsup:

maya: tagging docs link draft: https://go.redwood/partners/webhooks/delegated-reporting (WIP)

anna: noted. finance will loop in billing-ops for reconciliation playbook.

sahil: leaving this thread open for updates — if anyone posts objections, flag them here. otherwise i'll mark as green next week after eng check-in. :white_check_mark:
